units.source_text: 古歌：“杜宇若能通冥府，传言我正哭声哀。”

en.t: An old poem says, "If the cuckoo can pass into the underworld, tell them that I am weeping in sorrow."
This appears in the Kokin Wakashu.

units.source_text: 时人相信杜鹃能通冥府。

en.t: People of the time believed that the cuckoo could communicate with the underworld.
